name: rosetta-sorting-algorithms-counting-sort
code:
use default

counting_sort(values: List[int], low: int, high: int) -> List[int] is
    let counts = LIST()

    for _ in low..high + 1 do
        counts.add(0)
    od

    for value in values do
        counts[value - low] = counts[value - low] + 1
    od

    let result = LIST()

    for offset in 0..counts.count do
        for _ in 0..counts[offset] do
            result.add(offset + low)
        od
    od

    result
si

let numbers = [5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7, 1, 9]

write_line(counting_sort(numbers, 1, 9) |> join(", "))
